name: devbook
description: The devbook convention: .arc42, .domain, .tech, .design, and .ai folders of addressed Markdown chapters, each carrying a parseable meta block with status ladders, a shared approved rung and the review triad beside it, runnable test-case links, a reserved ext namespace, and annotation fences that keep a review note in the chapter beside the passage it is about. Ships the checker — build.mjs, which validates every meta block and reference and writes nothing unless a layered plugin asks it to — the fence writer, the reference-graph canvas, the .tech inventory scripts, three converters between chapters and code (sync-specs, apply-change, verify-change, each over five chapter kinds), check, annotation-sweep, tech-update, a versioned contract with runnable migrations, and the install that puts the rules, the tools, and its AGENTS.md section into a repository. Ships the shape and the check, never a flow: the delivery engine carries a chapter change, and devbook-derived keeps the committed _meta/ index fresh.
